QuestInfo.0: Meet up with Kanderune at Boulder Mountain Entrance and ask him about the giant boar.
QuestInfo.1: You must eliminate #b#e100 #o5250002##n#k monsters here so that people can safely climb Boulder Moutain.

0.0: So...even Loha has heard the rumors about that giant boar. I haven't seen it myself, but I've tracked an unusually large animal to the caves near here. I just need to figure out which one is its den...
0.1: Since you came all the way here, could you help me out?

yes.0: With so many people getting injured by the boars around here, I'd like you to clear some of them out. It's nothing excessive...maybe 100 or so? I know you must be busy.

no.0: You come all this way, and you just... Look, think it over, and come back, okay?

1.0: A #o5250002# is a dangerous foe...have you cleared them out?

yes.0: I had heard that you changed quite a bit... Looks like I heard right. Good job. I'll finish off the rest of the beasts here. Oh, there's one more thing...
